charter: Track the design, creation, modification, and maintenance of the skill-authoring skill: user intent, package structure, bundled doctrine and pattern references, meta artifact conventions, dogfooding evidence, live evaluations, accepted behavioral changes, and unresolved design questions. Admit sessions that create or modify skill-authoring. Exclude disposable CLI test sessions and sessions that only execute generated skills as separate members, while allowing their evidence to inform an admitted development session.
